About Me

From Wine Business
to Digital Growth

I started in the wine world — studying enology, working across production, brand development and commercial strategy. That background gave me something most marketing people don't have: a real understanding of how value is created before it's communicated.

The transition to digital growth wasn't a pivot away from that — it was an extension of it. I launched Vigna 360° as a D2C brand so I could learn performance marketing the only way that actually works: by running real campaigns, reading real data, and making real decisions with real consequences.

What I bring to marketing is a combination of brand intuition and analytical thinking — I care about the strategy behind the spend, the story behind the funnel, and the systems that make growth repeatable. AI and automation are now part of how I work, not just tools I know about.
